patch.summary:
Choose FlexiQuiz only if your buying job matches “Quiz and assessment software for training and education — affiliate partner in LMS & cours” rather than Breezy HR's shape. Choose Breezy HR only if your buying job matches “Mid-market ATS with free Bootstrap, paid Startup/Growth/Business pools, career site, and i” rather than FlexiQuiz's shape. Workflow advantage: FlexiQuiz leans learner-assessments, employee-training; Breezy HR leans recruiting-ats. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

- Positioning: FlexiQuiz is Quiz and assessment software for training and education — affiliate partner in LMS & course creation.; Breezy HR is Mid-market ATS with free Bootstrap, paid Startup/Growth/Business pools, career site, and interview workflows — Growth from $273/mo annual..

- Workflow coverage skew: FlexiQuiz-leaning learner-assessments, employee-training vs Breezy HR-leaning recruiting-ats.
- Researched limits: FlexiQuiz — Assessment/quiz scope — not full HRIS or LMS commerce; Breezy HR — Free Bootstrap limits to one active pool/position — not enough for multi-role hiring volume.
